rationale: The Lean proposition faithfully formalizes Theorem 2.8.4: it has the same independent centered uniformly bounded finite family, the same two-sided unnormalized tail event, the same second-moment variance quantity, and the exact constants and single-fraction exponent. Its additional measurability, integrability, positivity, and almost-everywhere details are rigorous resolutions of conditions implicit or ambiguous in the source. Arbitrary finite indexing is a harmless relabeling generalization, including a trivial empty case. Both implication directions therefore hold.
